verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a pip-installable Python framework whose bots launch from the command line. Its official CLI ran keylessly via uvx in a runtime probe and includes an `eval` command that runs behavioral tests against the real agent, which are the building blocks for headless or CI automation. However, no first-party documentation describes running in CI, non-interactive eval exit codes, or pipeline integration. missing for 10: documented CI/headless workflow guidance (e.g., CI pipeline examples, non-interactive eval pass/fail reporting), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: the official Pipecat CLI (pypi pipecat-ai[cli]) ran keylessly via uvx
